hints.title: Positive Integer Stream
hints.text: The set initially contains all positive integers 1, 2, 3, ...

hints.title: Pointer and Re-added Pool
hints.text: Maintain a threshold pointer representing the contiguous prefix of unpopped integers, and a distinct pool of smaller re-added numbers.

hints.title: Smallest Element Selection
hints.text: When popping, if the re-added pool has elements, pop its minimum; otherwise return the threshold pointer and advance it.

hints.title: Pointer and Set Heap Implementation

complexity.time: O(log k) for popSmallest and addBack
variables: k: count of re-added numbers below threshold
complexity.notes: Heap operations take logarithmic time in the count of re-added numbers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Materializing an infinite set upfront is impossible due to infinite memory constraints.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set and min heap together provide O(1) duplicate checks and O(log k) minimum retrieval.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Designs state using a continuous stream cursor combined with a min-heap for returned values.
